title: How to Improve Soil Anti-Adhesion by Studying the Micro Relief of the Cuticle Surface of Digging Beetles: Using Rotated Image with Maximum Average Power Spectrum Technique to Find the Predominant Directions of the Topographic Pattern
content: In recent years, our research has focused on the microtopography of different soil-digging beetles, with the aim of identifying the pattern responsible for reducing the adhesion of soil particles to agricultural machinery components [1, 2]. The main characteristic of the microtopography (micro relief) of the cuticular surface of the pronotum of these beetles is the presence of dimples apparently randomly distributed.
